name: MemoryArena
ontology_notes: Eval gym for interdependent multi-session agent tasks, not a memory engine and not a companion. Table 1. 766 tasks, 6.9 subtasks on average, 57 steps. Four environments. Bundled web shopping (150 tasks, 6 sessions, 41.5k trace), group travel planning (270, 5-9 sessions, 40.6k), progressive web search (256, 2-16, 122.4k), formal reasoning math (40) and phys (20). Metrics are task Success Rate and Progress Score, plus latency. User modeled is a web or planning agent, not a friend or RP character. Covers none of the ten companion holes. Hole 8 is adjacent only as subtask latency, not companion cost-per-turn. The steal is that LoCoMo-class recall saturation does not predict action. Paper states that as a qualitative claim and does not report LoCoMo scores for the Table 3 systems.

supersession.evidence: Later subtasks depend on earlier actions and environment feedback. That is state carry-over, not a scored overwrite of a biographical fact. He et al. arXiv 2602.16313 §3.1 and §4.2.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Multi-session loops with ordered subtasks. SR@k decays as dependency depth grows (Figure 3). No calendar-grounded companion reunion.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Group travel has named people with constraints. They are planning agents, not user vs character vs relationship vs lore types.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Success is completing the bundle, itinerary, search, or proof. No skip of a socially wrong recall.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No stored-text jailbreak or persona overwrite cases in the four environments.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: No user forget-that. Memory systems may compress traces. That is not a deletion command.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Table 4 reports subtask completion time in seconds. Long-context GPT-5.1-mini avg 74.2s. Letta 132.8s. Mem0 114.8s. External memory is slower. This is agent wall time, not companion tokens-per-turn.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Code on ZexueHe/MemoryArena and data on Hugging Face ZexueHe/memoryarena. GitHub SPDX null and HF license null on 2026-09-11. README requires vendor API keys (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Letta, Mirix, Mem0).
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Selects agents that keep interdependent web, travel, search, and math state across sessions. Domain is not a companion. A LoCoMo winner can still fail here, which is the steal, but winning MemoryArena would not select a companion store.

published_eval.name: MemoryArena
published_eval.claimed_score: Table 3. All methods low SR. Group travel SR near 0. GPT-5.1-mini long-context All-task avg SR 0.16. Memory-agent avg SR about 0.12 to 0.15 (Letta 0.15, Mem0 0.14). Abstract. Agents near-saturated on LoCoMo perform poorly here. Paper does not table those LoCoMo numbers.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Whether memory distilled from earlier agent-environment steps lets the agent finish later interdependent subtasks (Success Rate and Progress Score) in shopping, group travel, progressive search, and formal reasoning. Not conversational fact QA and not companion identity.

open_unknowns: No LICENSE on GitHub or Hugging Face as of 2026-09-11.
Table 1 says 766 tasks. Environment counts 150+270+256+40+20=736. Using Table 1's 766 and the per-environment counts as published.
LoCoMo near-saturation is stated in the abstract and §1. The paper does not report the matching LoCoMo scores for Table 3 systems.
